acquisition method: The proteome of midgut secretions of larval stages of L. noctiluca was analyzed using both top-down and bottom-up strategies
alkylation reagent: prior to the reduction and alkylation with dithiothreitol and chloracetamide
cleavage agent: 25 µg of the sample was digested with trypsin
collision energy: The run was performed at a resolution of 35,000, AGC target at 3 × 106, a maximum injection time of 240 ms, and 28 eV normalized collision energy
fractionation method: a poly ( styrene divinylbenzene) reversed-phase (RP) StageTip purification protocol was used
fragmentation method: To obtain fragment spectra with the Q-Exactive Plus, HCD fragmentations were performed
instrument: The final proteomic analysis was performed with a Q-Exactive Plus (Thermo Fisher Scientific) mass spectrometer... Mass spectra of midgut secretions were generated on a Bruker ultrafleXtreme TOF/TOF mass spectrometer
ionization type: MALDI-TOF mass spectra of repeatedly released midgut secretions
labeling: The proteome of midgut secretions of larval stages of L. noctiluca was analyzed using both top-down and bottom-up strategies
reduction reagent: prior to the reduction and alkylation with dithiothreitol and chloracetamide
